run_gguf_copy_with_new_metadata: run the gguf_new_metadata script to copy a GGUF model file with new metadata values
run_gguf_set_chat_template: run the gguf_new_metadata script to set a chat template on a GGUF model from a jinja file
run_gguf_update_special_token: run the gguf_new_metadata script to update special token IDs in a GGUF model
run_gguf_remove_metadata: run the gguf_new_metadata script to remove specified metadata keys from a GGUF model
run_gguf_update_model_name: run the gguf_new_metadata script to update the general name and description of a GGUF model
